Apparition is formidable, far larger than hero but translucent enough to read sky behind; broad sculptural dragon anatomy, no solid pet, no cyan, no full-screen light rays. Composition theme is LOYALTY and PROTECTIVE divine escort, not attack.
At far left edge behind them a small quiet roadside departure pavilion contains a CLOSED sealed chest of gold and a suspended official seal on its post, a tiny subordinate visual trace of leaving wealth and rank behind. Keep this on the same continuous landscape, not inset/collage, no duplicate Guan Yu. No prominent writing here.
Original mythic Three Kingdoms manga hero illustration: intentional dramatic geometric armor and cloth shapes, smooth sculpted face planes, bold designed silhouettes, sweeping composition, stylized materials and clouds, heroic but grounded mountain world, not photorealism with added particles, no floating palaces.
